def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models first, optimize relocations, then apply improving swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    # Large models are placed first so smaller models cannot fragment the
    # remaining capacity and make an otherwise feasible placement fail.
    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += pressure

    # Evaluate every feasible relocation and make only the one that gives the
    # greatest exact reduction of the maximum GPU KVPR.
    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    dst_ratio = (
                        (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining
                        if remaining else float("inf")
                    )
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_move = src, dst, model, size, pressure

        if best_move is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size
        free[dst] -= size
        load[src] -= pressure
        load[dst] += pressure

    # A relocation local optimum can still be improved by exchanging two models.
    # Keep only strictly KVPR-reducing, memory-feasible swaps.
    for _ in range(2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score, best_swap = max(ratios), None

        for left_gpu in range(gpu_num):
            for right_gpu in range(left_gpu + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[left_gpu]:
                    left_size = left.model_size
                    left_load = left.req_rate / left.slo
                    for right in placement[right_gpu]:
                        right_size = right.model_size
                        right_load = right.req_rate / right.slo
                        left_free = free[left_gpu] + left_size - right_size
                        right_free = free[right_gpu] + right_size - left_size
                        if left_free <= 0 or right_free <= 0:
                            continue
                        score = max(
                            (load[left_gpu] - left_load + right_load) / left_free
                            if i == left_gpu else
                            (load[right_gpu] - right_load + left_load) / right_free
                            if i == right_gpu else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score = score
                            best_swap = left_gpu, right_gpu, left, right, left_free, right_free, left_load, right_load

        if best_swap is None:
            break
        left_gpu, right_gpu, left, right, left_free, right_free, left_load, right_load = best_swap
        placement[left_gpu].remove(left)
        placement[right_gpu].remove(right)
        placement[left_gpu].append(right)
        placement[right_gpu].append(left)
        free[left_gpu], free[right_gpu] = left_free, right_free
        load[left_gpu] += right_load - left_load
        load[right_gpu] += left_load - right_load

    return placement

    weighted_req_rate = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]   # sum of r_j / s_j per GPU

    for model in sorted_models:
